records.title: Video Understanding: From Geometry and Semantics to Unified Models
records.reason: Survey of video understanding topics; no concrete inference optimization result.

records.title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Tool verification improves test-time RL reliability through external evidence; it adds adaptation/training work rather than optimizing inference.

records.title: MSJoE: Jointly Evolving MLLM and Sampler for Efficient Long-Form Video Understanding
records.reason: MSJoE jointly trains an MLLM and frame sampler. It improves video QA, but its efficiency appendix reports total time about 30% above uniform sampling even though the QA step is 10% faster through prefix-cache hits; the net pipeline efficiency is therefore workload-dependent.

records.title: MC-GRPO: Median-Centered Group Relative Policy Optimization for Small-Rollout Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: MC-GRPO changes small-rollout reinforcement-learning training, not inference.

records.title: MixFusion: A Patch-Level Parallel Serving System for Mixed-Resolution Diffusion Models
records.reason: The primary ACM page exposes the abstract but the publisher full-text/PDF could not be retrieved in this environment (open returned an internal fetch error). Its abstract describes T2I diffusion serving, so the paper remains borderline and the system/evaluation details could not be checked.
